correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md and verify_c48_flex.py. Smoothness from simultaneous first derivatives; Hessian det=108Y^2 Z(8X^3-Z^3) over Z[1/6]. Intersections: Y=0 gives four simple-in-Y curve points with Hessian order 2 and line contact 4; Z=0 gives four simple intersections with contact 3; 8X^3=Z^3 gives 12 simple intersections with Y^4=-9 zeta3^j/16. Total Hessian degree 4*6=24 accounts for all points. Hyperflex and infinity labels generate Q(zeta3) and Q(zeta8), respectively, whose compositum is Q(zeta24). Unit-group action on explicitly listed cyclotomic coordinates has orbit sizes 1,1,2,4,4,8; Frobenius acts by q mod24, and p^2=1 mod24 for p>3. Independent exact symbolic Hessian, Galois action and direct prime-field counts p=5,7,11,13,17,19,23 passed. Finite primes corroborate, not justify the all-prime formula.
